Flow.description: Flow to Update Close Date Field on Opportunity Whenever Stage is updated to Closed Won or Closed Lost
Flow.interviewLabel: Update Close Date On Opportunity Update {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Update Close Date On Opportunity Update

recordUpdates.description: Element to Update the Close Date field whenever an Opportunity is Updated to Closed Won or Closed Lost
recordUpdates.name: Update_Close_Date
recordUpdates.label: Update Close Date

start.filterFormula: AND( ISCHANGED({!$Record.StageName}), OR( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.StageName}, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.StageName}, "Closed Lost") ), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL({!$Record__Prior.StageName}, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record__Prior.StageName}, "Closed Lost") ) ), NOT(ISCHANGED( {!$Record.CloseDate})), OR( {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'Finance', {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'LCV_Opportunity' ) )
